text:
miguel: heads up — scorecard drilldown for the quantized run shows weird negative precision values in the diff panel, looks off. attaching payload link and quick notes.
sara: can you paste the run id and any repro steps? :eyes:
miguel: run id `2026-03-10_qa-quant-42`. repro: Console -> Evaluations -> select run -> Diff view -> switch to "per-prompt" -> enable "quantized" variant. numbers jump and tooltip shows negative precision.
rachel: I think I've seen a similar UI issue — sometimes the drilldown reduces mismatched keys and the aggregator ends up doing a bad divide. pinging @alex for dashboard transform sanity check. :bug:
alex: looking. quick theory: frontend does `sum(correct)` / `sum(total)` but the maps contain mismatched prompt keys after runner dedup, which introduced negative totals.
ci-bot: CI triggered for branch `dashboard/fix-agg-keys` (build 4598) — queued.
miguel: pasted raw payload here: https://artifacts.internal/runs/2026-03-10_qa-quant-42/payload.json
sara: can someone paste a snippet of the metric def used by the runner?
miguel: metric snippet from harness: ```
metric_def = {"name": "strict_exact_match", "type": "proportion", "treat_null_as": 0}
# runner emits per-prompt: {prompt_id: {"correct": int, "total": int}}
```
alex: I pulled the payload — there's a `null` for `correct` on prompt `p-17` and a `-1` in `total` for prompt `p-23`. runner shouldn't emit negatives. suspect quantized scorer rounding underflow turned into signed-int wrap in C-binding path.
rachel: that matches the quantize experiment notes — we saw odd underflow when logits clipped and then cast to int for some counters.
sara: temporary mitigation: clamp counts in the evaluator output and in the dashboard aggregation to avoid negative or >total values. e.g. `correct = max(0, min(correct, total))`. also add a unit test in the harness.
alex: adding clamping in dashboard as a safety net too. will change aggregation to explicitly align keys before reduce and compute `sum(correct)/sum(total)`. also add a tooltip describing weighted vs unweighted aggregation.
miguel: repro steps and payload attached to the ticket. created internal issue ML-3372.
ci-bot: CI 4598: build passed, running integration tests.
eval-bot: new eval run posted after harness patch: `2026-03-10_qa-quant-42v2` — quick diff shows numbers sane, no negative precision.
alex: PR #789 created: clamp runner outputs, key-align aggregation, add unit + integration tests. adding a small migration to patch dashboards on staging.
ci-bot: deployment to staging succeeded at 1791235120.
miguel: verified staging — diff panel values stable, precision between 0 and 1. will schedule prod run after one more smoke test.
sara: follow-ups: 1) add telemetry anomaly rule to fire if any precision < 0 or > 1; 2) doc PR to explain aggregation semantics (weighted mean vs per-prompt unweighted) for scorecards.
rachel: also recommend a quick audit of other quantize-run payloads from last 2 weeks. could be more intermittent.
alex: adding telemetry alert to backlog and kicking off search for recent runs with out-of-bounds counts.
miguel: file for docs: https://docs.internal/scorecards/aggregation-guidelines (will submit tiny PR after prod check).
sara: thanks everyone — great triage. :thumbsup:
(eval-bot): summary: 1) Root cause: runner produced invalid counts in rare quantized path; 2) Immediate fixes: clamp outputs in harness + safe aggregation in dashboard; 3) Next steps: telemetry alerts + docs + audit of recent runs.
